description: This Java source file defines the EntityEcaAction class within the org.apache.ofbiz.entityext.eca package. The class encapsulates logic for executing entity-related actions, such as invoking services synchronously or asynchronously, with configurable attributes like service name, mode, user context, and error handling. It provides constructors, runAction method to trigger the service, and overrides for toString, hashCode, and equals methods.

classes.name: EntityEcaAction
classes.description: Encapsulates configuration and execution logic for entity-conditional actions, mainly invoking services with specified modes and error handling strategies.

methods.name: getServiceName
methods.description: Returns the name of the service to execute.

methods.name: runAction
methods.description: Executes the configured service action, handling synchronization, user context, result processing, and error/rollback strategies.
